message: ぴろーとーく

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. I have a little secret to tell you」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but we never know when everyone might show up here」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya! Understood. Thank you very much」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is quite alright. Jiiya handled things well」

name: Synn
message: 「Handled things well...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya is holding everyone off so they will not come here」
I want to ask, though it's probably better if I don't.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Furthermore, I also have a final line of defense」

name: Synn
message: 「A final line of defense?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I hung a 'Bathing' sign out front」

name: Synn
message: 「Why 'Bathing'?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because only death awaits anyone who barges in while a maiden is bathing」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's totally hopeless, man」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister! Are you not in?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!? I did not account for the shrine maiden!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh? Bathing!? How rude of me. Only death awaits those who enter while a maiden is bathing, after all. I shall come back later」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It worked」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you serious」

name: Synn
message: 「Try to wrap this up as quick as you can, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It lacks a certain atmosphere for confessing secrets, but it cannot be helped」
Lolotte took one deep breath, then solemnly opened her mouth.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. In truth, I have two grave secrets」

name: Synn
message: 「What are they?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't be shocked when you hear this. Truth be told, I am an angel. I trust you, President, so I am confiding in you」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well, I had no idea. What a shock. Right, Paqy?\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-Yeah. The great me is shocked too. I see, I see, that's amazing\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Keeping it hidden weighed heavily on my heart, so I feel a little relieved now」

name: Synn
message: 「Um...... but why all of a sudden?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, it ties into another secret. If anything, that one is even more important」
Lolotte took another deep breath and opened her mouth gravely.

name: Lolotte
message: 「In truth, Azel is an angel as well」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's what it was......」
Since Azel often spoke about humans with an oddly detached perspective, I had suspected she might be from another world, though.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold on. Why is she in this world, then? Setting aside a sightseeing tourist like you, she's dead serious」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What do you mean, sightseeing tourist! I came here to investigate and experience the enjoyable events of the Human World to satisfy my spirit of inquiry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please call me a cute little explorer」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's literally a sightseeing tourist」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, do you know the reason Azel came here?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Before I tell you that...... President, don't you find it strange that Azel is the only one constantly being attacked by demons?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I was wondering about that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My hunch is that the demons targeting Azel has something to do with Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「Any proof?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel is one of the members of an investigation team dispatched from Heaven to study the effects this Re-Crea will have on the Three Realms」
Which means Azel knows more about Re-Crea than any of us.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, you're doubting me! I heard it straight from Azel's own mouth, so there is no mistake!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even after the other members withdrew back to Heaven, it seems she volunteered to remain in the Human World」
Then does that mean her apparent love for cameras is just for her investigation too......

name: Lolotte
message: 「According to my brilliant deduction, you see, during her investigation Azel accidentally uncovered some outrageous secret regarding this Re-Crea that she can't tell anyone」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't that what the demons are targeting?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, man. Even if that's true, I don't think Azel's gonna blab that secret so easily」

name: Synn
message: 「She does seem tight-lipped by nature」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's where you'll work your charm, President」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm no good at that kind of thing」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, Master Synn, for someone so dense, you're a real lady-killer」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be fine. From what I can see, you and Azel are quite close, President, so before long, during pillow talk--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Going straight to R-rated stuff, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「What's pillow talk?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It refers to the insults traded back and forth during a pillow fight」

name: Synn
message: 「A pillow fight with Azel... I'll try my best」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you for real?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Keep this a secret from everyone. Including the fact that I'm an angel, of course」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone already kno--... No, I'll keep it a secret」

name: Bylous
message: 「Less than a month remains until Re-Crea」

name: Bylous
message: 「The day our wish is granted draws near」

name: Soltia
message: 「'Our,' you say」
Bylous gave a somewhat cold smile and looked toward Pasta.

name: Bylous
message: 「Pasta. Is the construction of the magic circle going smoothly?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Yes, nya」

name: Bylous
message: 「Any interference from the Student Council?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Progress is slightly delayed because we're avoiding their patrols, though it's still well within the margin of error」

name: Bylous
message: 「Hmm... It seems you're doing a great job, Pasta」

name: Pasta
message: 「Yes, nya!」

name: Bylous
message: 「And how are things with the Student Council?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing in particular. Preparations for the Holy Night Festival. Training. Patrols」

name: Soltia
message: 「The Holy Night Festival... Ah, the event scheduled for the day of Re-Crea」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right」

name: Pasta
message: 「I hear there's a dance party at the end, nya. Pasta wants to try dancing with someone she likes too, nya」
For some reason, Bylous laughed.

name: Bylous
message: 「I'll be having a dance with the Demon Lord myself」

name: Soltia
message: 「So the number of cameras has increased again」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you want?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Isn't that a bit rude to say to Ms. Sengen'in?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Do you like that boy?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Synn Sakura is merely a target for surveillance」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hmm. I didn't mention any specific name, though?」

name: Azel
message: 「Simple deduction. He's the only guy in the Student Council」

name: Soltia
message: 「I see. Then that's fine」

name: Soltia
message: 「So your business with that boy is just a way to kill time, then」

name: Azel
message: 「...What about you? Why are you participating in this scheme?」

name: Soltia
message: 「What a foolish question. The sole goal we all agreed upon despite our different positions--that's to ensure Re-Crea occurs, isn't it?」

name: Azel
message: 「The destruction of the world. What benefit does that bring to you?」

name: Azel
message: 「Bylous most likely thinks that if the Gates collapse and the boundaries separating the three realms vanish, he'll be able to invade Heaven from the Demon World or something」

name: Azel
message: 「Pasta is merely following Bylous out of irrational emotions」

name: Azel
message: 「But you're different--you should know the world will be destroyed when the Re-Crea reaches criticality」

name: Soltia
message: 「The world won't be destroyed. It will simply be recreated as it should be.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet you won't exist in that new world」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's right. The current me won't be there. But that's just fine.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why」

name: Soltia
message: 「Because I'll be reborn and become an angel.」
Soltia laughed as if she couldn't contain her delight at the thought.
